text.en:
Section 1 of Executive Order No. 448, dated
June 9, 1951, is hereby amended hy reducing and setting
up new ceiling prices for galvanized roofing nails as
CONSTRUCTION MATERIALS (IMPORTED)
With 17 per cent Special Excise Tax on Foreign Exchange
Unit Wholesaler's Retailer's
Galvanized Roofing Nail-
1.05
1.15
SEc. 2. The ceiling prices fixed in this Order include
the 17 per cent special excise tax on foreign exchange,
7 per cent sales tax and 1 per cent municipal tax.

This Order shall take effect three days after
the date hereof.
•
Done in the City of Manila, this 12th day of Sep-
tember, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
fifty-three, and of the Independence of the Philippines,
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
By the President:
MARCIANO ROQUE
Acting Executive Secretary
